openings.claim: Authoritative ledger, reservation IDs, verbal change read-backs and dated online synchronization may prevent conflicting expectations.
openings.probe: Trial within staffing; measure conflicts and administration.
openings.uncertainty: Two conflicts have unknown causes; shared-ledger practicality and added workload remain uncertain.

openings.claim: Recorded needs may expose feasible reallocation or binding window/equipment scarcity.
openings.discriminator: A feasible allocation versus demonstrated unavoidable shortfall.
openings.probe: Ask contacts for duration, acceptable alternatives and equipment; construct eight-week paper allocation. Verify suitability and reliability before counting outside rehearsals.
openings.uncertainty: Reports may err; 60 minutes need not satisfy full need; unsuccessful search cannot prove infeasibility.

openings.claim: Shared indispensable players may cause overlapping groups' lateness or absence.
openings.discriminator: Attendance improves after supported overlaps are removed.
openings.probe: Compare missed/late and timely sessions through contact accounts; if supported, trial accepted staggering; measure usable minutes, unmet needs and administration.
openings.uncertainty: Shared membership and causal necessity are unmeasured.

openings.claim: Consented exchanges among three-plus bookings may satisfy excluded requests beyond direct swaps.
openings.discriminator: A cycle adds satisfied need without reducing another group's satisfaction; no cycle rejects this opening for these bookings.
openings.probe: Map acceptable windows/piano necessity; compare swaps and cycles. Obtain full consent, confirm assignments and reconcile calendars before activation; measure needs, conflicts and all coordination time.
openings.uncertainty: Compatible flexibility is unknown; setup may exceed administration target.

decision: Probe hypotheses; synthetic observations establish none. Preserve two rooms/24 staffed hours, requested weekly minimum, phone/in-person access, equipment, no fees and both performances. Evaluate eight-week 90% needs, fewer than two conflicts and at most two administration hours weekly; aggregate vacancy or lateness proves no recoverable capacity.
